legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera lowers and pushes in slowly and steadily toward the fire circle until the flames fill the frame and the background is only dark night and trees. Calm crackling fire, nothing flies through the air, no floating flames, no sparks above any building.

Single continuous camera move, no cuts. From close beside the fire the camera slowly tilts straight up, following many small glowing embers that drift gently upward from the flames like fireflies, until the frame is a deep night sky full of stars and the Milky Way with treetops at the edges. Soft tiny embers only, no streaks, no fireworks, no buildings.
